rows.item_specific_instructions: The Art Institute image 1993.60 is Penitent Saint Peter, not the selected apostolate painting. Find exact apostolate object in institutional inventory; do not substitute the Chicago picture.

rows.item_specific_instructions: Resolve which Ribera Saint Paul belongs to approved apostolate before any new photo acquisition.

rows.item_specific_instructions: Find exact image of Prado's anonymous Saint Augustine, P001314. The old Lanfranco Coronation of Virgin candidate is a different painting.

rows.why_current_source_is_unacceptable: Museum confirms Rubens's Miracles of St Ignatius, but proposed 'Detail - Glory of St Ignatius' is explicitly a detail/crop. Cannot certify original full-composition reproduction.
rows.item_specific_instructions: Identify a full-work source reproduction of Rubens Miracles of Saint Ignatius, KHM GG517, not a detail/crop labelled Glory of Ignatius.

rows.why_current_source_is_unacceptable: Van Dyck Christ between two criminals could be related to the Lance Thrust, but title alone cannot resolve the exact painting and variant.
rows.item_specific_instructions: Resolve Lance Thrust vs alternate Crucifixion between criminals painting; verify inventory, original work and source photo.

rows.why_current_source_is_unacceptable: The proposed file is VIA_CRUCIS_VIII (women of Jerusalem), not XII (Christ raised and dead on cross). Do not attach even as a provisional XII artwork.
rows.item_specific_instructions: Locate image explicitly labelled San Polo Via Crucis XII, state inventory 0500220372A-12; never use station VIII Women's Jerusalem picture.
